power_convention: Positive requested W charges; negative discharges. battery_watts is -V*I from inverter telemetry. Main export meter positive exports, negative imports.
limitations: Power phases last approximately 12 seconds, including ramp and transport delay; they do not prove long-term tracking.
Readback confirmation is distinct from measured DC/AC power.
The cabin reserve was 80% on-grid and 0% off-grid during the first test run; both were restored to 20% before subsequent runs.
No hardware return-to-auto watchdog was demonstrated on either installed firmware.
